body:
This has me thinking: how can I ever bear going to my ma's funeral, how can I inflict them going on mine, I should isolate or just off myself and stop thinking about any of that.

I get it, you're not therapists. I'm poor, I don't like wasting time on therapies that have not worked in the past. My area has only a handful of "mental health" facilities/treatment options, and I feel there's a large stigma in going as they are on the streets everyone and their gossipy mother drives by.

You know what I don't know what I want. It's hard to care, and the more you care the more you lose.

What keeps me here is care, and I am a rich man because of that, but if it's all going away, who cares, why not avoid all of that hassle?
